message.content:

1. **Which cases do you want me to look at?**  
   If you know the docket numbers (or even just the parties involved), please share them so I can pull up the full judgments.

2. **Are there particular metrics you’re interested in?**  
   For example, “most influential” could mean largest monetary award, highest court level, precedent‑setting rulings, media coverage, etc.

Once I’ve got those specifics, I can fetch the relevant case files using our internal database and give you an overview of why each one mattered.
